description: Closed local authored source manifest (maximum 1 MiB, 1000 members). Paths resolve relative to the original manifest parent. Domain validation rejects traversal, symlinks, self-reference, duplicate/overlapping paths and undeclared entry. Every member hash and size is verified. Managed imports preserve exact manifest bytes at the core-assigned payload path and map members into its sibling payload.members/ closure root; resolve through AssetRegistry.open_source_members, not by concatenating manifest parent paths. No ArtifactRecord or AssetTransaction extension is required.
